name: Denmark Open
stakes: With several early exits, the remaining Indian contingent faces a critical week to salvage pride, gain crucial ranking points, and demonstrate their prowess on the Super 750 stage.
summary:
India's campaign at the Denmark Open, a Super 750 event, has seen a mixed start as the tournament progresses past its initial rounds. Several key singles players, including PV Sindhu, Lakshya Sen, and HS Prannoy, faced early exits in the Round of 32, highlighting the tough competition at this level. Sindhu, in particular, had a challenging draw that saw her bow out swiftly.

However, hopes remain alive in the doubles categories and with some of the younger singles talents. The top-ranked men's doubles pair of Satwik & Chirag are still in contention, with their R32 clash against He-Ren on the cards. Meanwhile, the promising women's doubles duo of Treesa & Gayatri, and young singles talent Malvika Bansod, are also looking to make their mark as their R32 draws unfold. This week presents a crucial opportunity for the remaining Indian contingent to make a deep run and gather valuable ranking points.
